changelog.what: First version, written from the published rows with nothing in the way.

question: Do you want your agent to read through your mail and chats to find context?
worry: You asked it to answer one email. To be thorough it searches years of your mail and chats: the HR thread, the personal one, the one about the deal that is not announced.
you_get: The agent reads what the task is about, and asks before it goes looking wider.
line: Only read the messages, threads or documents I point you to; ask before searching my mail or chats more widely.
paragraph: My mail and chats hold things that are not mine alone. Read the messages I name. If you need more context, tell me what you would search for and in which account, and wait for a yes. Never read threads labelled HR, legal, medical or personal unless I name them.

stronger.what: An organisation's admin can set a claude.ai connector tool to ask
stronger.how: Set by the organisation's admin for each connector tool; the setting also reaches Claude Code sessions.
stronger.quote: If your organization has set a claude.ai connector tool to ask and that setting reaches Claude Code in your session, allow rules for that tool don't take effect: Claude Code prompts on every call, even in auto and bypassPermissions modes.
